summary: AMPSA furnished a 6-K attaching a press release noting controlling shareholder Ardagh Holdings S.A.'s update on its sales process. No price, stake, premium or timeline disclosed; press release lives on AHSA's IR site. AMPSA states no board recommendation or advisor. Structurally the event concerns AHSA's ownership of the parent, not an AMPSA asset sale, so no AMPSA deal mechanics, overhang or regulatory clock are specified. For risk-arb, monitor AHSA's release for terms, buyer identity and whether any transaction touches AMPSA's free float or control.
